title: CVE-2026-22689: Mailpit — CSWSH tanpa validasi Origin
related: lab-41-mailpit-cswsh-bypass: regresi fix ini — bypass cek Origin via path percent-encoded (CVE-2026-67448)
summary: WebSocket upgrader Mailpit disetel CheckOrigin: return true (axllent/mailpit < 1.28.2, Go/gorilla; CVE-2026-22689, CVSS 6.5) — halaman asing bisa membuka socket ke ws://localhost:8025/api/events dan menerima siaran event email (subjek, pengirim, cuplikan isi) secara real-time. Fix 1.28.2: hapus CheckOrigin (default gorilla: Origin harus cocok Host). Lab: server WebSocket asli stdlib (handshake 101 + text frame); exploit contract STATUS/EVENT_ID/EVENT_SUBJECT, bukti lewat GET /api/events; fix = tolak Origin yang host-nya != Host → 403.

title: CVE-2026-34383: Admidio — penegakan CSRF kondisional pada input penyerang
summary: Parameter POST 'imported' yang dikontrol penyerang memutuskan apakah validasi token CSRF dan validasi form dijalankan (admidio/admidio <= 5.0.7, PHP; pelapor @offset) — request tempaan tanpa token valid menyimpan item mentah ke inventory, termasuk quantity invalid yang pasti ditolak validasi normal; CVSS 4.3. Fixed 5.0.8 (commit 00494b95). Lab: mock stdlib modul inventory; exploit contract STATUS/ITEM_ID, bukti lewat GET /inventory (quantity negatif/non-integer); fix = token CSRF + validasi form selalu dijalankan — flag request tak boleh mengendalikan penegakan.

title: CVE-2026-34394: AVideo — CSRF config plugin → takeover platform
summary: POST /admin/save.json.php menulis field POST arbitrer ke konfigurasi plugin tanpa pernah memanggil isGlobalTokenValid()/verifyToken() (WWBN/AVideo <= 26.0, PHP; pelapor aisafe.io) — request tempaan bermodal cookie sesi admin mengubah paypalReceiverEmail plugin PayPerView; diperparah cookie SameSite=None yang eksplisit dan mass-assignment tanpa allowlist; CVSS 8.1. Fix anjuran advisory: isGlobalTokenValid() di save.json.php:10. Lab: mock stdlib panel admin (tanpa MySQL); exploit contract STATUS/PLUGIN/PAYPAL_EMAIL, bukti lewat GET /admin/plugins; fix = token CSRF divalidasi tepat setelah cek admin → 403 fail-closed.

title: CVE-2026-38529: Krayin CRM BOLA → password reset → ATO
related: lab-32-indico-principals-bola: both are BOLA in real open-source software; Krayin allows password reset → ATO, Indico leaks PII
summary: PUT /admin/settings/users/edit/{id} with form-urlencoded password=... resets any non-admin user's password — gate checked roles ((caller non-admin) && (target non-admin)) but never ownership, CWE-269 + CWE-639. Affects Krayin CRM 2.2.x (tested commit ba25b7e7), CVSS 8.8. Lab: mock CRM (stdlib-only); attacker id 100 resets victim id 1's password then logs in as victim → ATO; exploit contract STATUS/VICTIM_TOKEN, token proven via independent /me oracle; fix = owner-or-admin → 403, self-edit and admin-edit still work.

title: CVE-2026-67448: Mailpit — bypass cek Origin WebSocket via path percent-encoded
related: lab-40-mailpit-cswsh: regresi dari fix Lab 40 — middleware Origin menguji URI mentah sedangkan router memakai path ter-decode
summary: Regresi CVE-2026-22689 di axllent/mailpit 1.29.0–1.30.5: perbaikan CSWSH diimplementasikan ulang sebagai middleware Origin di server.go yang gate-nya menguji URI mentah (strings.HasPrefix(r.RequestURI, \"/api/\")), sedangkan http.ServeMux me-route path yang sudah ter-decode dan upgrader WebSocket tetap CheckOrigin: return true. Request ke /%61pi/events melewatkan satu-satunya cek Origin lalu ter-route ke handler /api/events — halaman asing kembali menerima siaran event email (subjek, pengirim, cuplikan isi) secara real-time. Fix 1.30.6: gate pada r.URL.Path (ter-decode) dan upgrader memvalidasi Origin sendiri secara fail-closed. Lab: diferensial 403 (path polos) vs 101 (path ter-encode); fix dua lapis ala upstream.

lab-26-expo-oauth-openredirect: both are redirect-driven token theft → ATO; Khan bypasses an unescaped-dot regex, Expo bypasses a case-sensitive scheme check
summary: Login continue validated by KA_DOMAIN_REGEX with unescaped dots in uc.a.run.app — attacker-registered xfarr-6fmjyrz2lq-uc-a-run.app passed, so post-login redirect carried a one-time transfer auth token (/transfer_auth?key=) to the attacker; replayed for full session cookies → 1-click ATO. Lab: mock login + transfer_auth; fix = escape the dots.

title: php2shell — CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619: unauthenticated RCE in PHP core
related: lab-20-php-filter-chain: sama-sama RCE yang berakar di runtime PHP, bukan logika aplikasi — filter chain butuh sink include di aplikasi, php2shell berjalan dari request mentah sebelum kode aplikasi dieksekusi
summary: Dua kerentanan memory corruption di core PHP, bukan di aplikasi. CVE-2026-109618 (GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w): fatal out-of-memory via longjmp di tengah inisialisasi request (parsing multipart/POST) meninggalkan bucket HashTable setengah terinisialisasi yang tetap dikonsumsi teardown saat request shutdown — RCE pre-auth, terkonfirmasi di mod_php sebelum kode aplikasi berjalan. CVE-2026-109619 (GHSA-6wmf-4rv5-p3rp): state global sisa satu request menunjuk memori request yang sudah dibebaskan (use-after-free) dan dikonsumsi request berikutnya pada worker yang sama; jalur terkonfirmasi termasuk session upload progress yang aktif secara default. Jalur kode rentan ada sejak PHP 5.4.0; semua SAPI web terdampak (mod_php, PHP-FPM, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed), konfigurasi default, tanpa login; RCE terkonfirmasi terhadap WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, Magento dan lainnya. CVSS v4 9.2 (AC:H / AT:P). Fix resmi 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35 plus backport source untuk 7.4–8.1; tidak ada mitigasi konfigurasi yang tuntas — update adalah satu-satunya perbaikan. Eksploitasi in-the-wild teramati sejak hari disclosure, 21 Oktober 2026. Berstatus candidate dan bukan lab: bug berada di interpreter C dan eksploitasinya bergantung pada layout heap serta timing antar-request, sehingga belum ada exploit publik terverifikasi yang deterministik untuk diverifikasi otomatis ala fixthecode.

title: WordPress file inclusion (CVE-2026-87902)

summary: Double-encoded pagename + numeric page_id make get_page_template() include a local PHP file outside the theme directory — realpath() canonicalizes but never proves containment. Conditional RCE via pearcmd.php.

title: CVE-2025-53640: Indico BOLA /api/principals → PII exposure
related: lab-29-valve-cdkeys-idor: both are missing object authorization → mass exposure; Indico exposes user PII, Valve exposes game CD keys
lab-33-krayin-bola-password-reset: both are BOLA in real open-source software; Indico leaks PII, Krayin allows password reset → ATO
summary: POST /api/principals with {\"values\":[\"User:<id>\"]} dumped name/email/affiliation for arbitrary user IDs — no authorization check on the object reference, CWE-639. Affects Indico 2.2–3.3.6, fixed in 3.3.7. Lab: mock principals API (stdlib-only); analyst User:100 enumerates User:1–5 and extracts EMAIL1 (amelia.hartono@lab.test) via POST {\"values\":[\"User:<id>\"]}; exploit contract STATUS/COUNT/EMAIL1, enumeration proven via independent server-side oracle; fix = resolve only self (if u and v == me) → foreign IDs return invalid, no PII leaks, self-resolution still works.

title: CVE-2025-68434: OpenSourcePOS — CSRF klasik tanpa token
summary: Global CSRF filter commented out with a TODO in app/Config/Filters.php (OpenSourcePOS 3.4.0/3.4.1, PHP/CodeIgniter) — every POST, including admin endpoints, rides the session cookie alone. Attacker's auto-submit form creates a rogue full-privilege Administrator when a logged-in admin visits it → complete POS system takeover, CVSS 8.8. Fixed in 3.4.2 (commit d575c8da). Lab: stdlib-only mock of the vulnerable POST /users; exploit contract STATUS/ADMIN_TOKEN, admin takeover proven via /me oracle (is_admin=true); fix = per-session CSRF token required on every POST → 403 without a valid token.

title: CVE-2025-68481: fastapi-users — login CSRF via OAuth state
summary: OAuth state parameter in fastapi-users < 15.0.2 was a stateless JWT (generate_state_token() always called with empty state_data) — valid ~1h for any client; the callback validated only signature and expiry, never binding state to the initiating session. Trick a logged-in victim into loading the attacker's callback URL (code + state) → attacker's upstream SSO identity permanently linked to the victim's account: '1-click Account Takeover' per the vendor advisory. Fixed in 15.0.2 (double-submit cookie, commit 7cf413cd). Lab: stdlib-only mock of the OAuth authorize/callback flow with a stub SSO provider; exploit contract STATUS/VICTIM/ATO_TOKEN, takeover proven via /me oracle plus an independent SSO-login replay; fix = double-submit cookie (oauth_csrf, HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax, compare_digest at callback → 400 fail-closed), mirroring the upstream patch.

title: HTTP/1.1 Must Die: The Desync Endgame
summary: 0.CL desync via Expect: 100-continue — the desync endgame. Servers that assume Content-Length is always present can be desynced.

title: CVE-2024-22424: Argo CD — CSRF via SameSite/cookie-scoping bypass
summary: Argo CD relied on SameSite=Lax as its CSRF defense — but SameSite is a site (eTLD+1) boundary, not an origin boundary, so an attacker on any sibling subdomain still gets the auth cookie; missing Content-Type validation let preflight-less requests reach state-changing API endpoints. Upwind demonstrated end-to-end: forged cross-site API calls deploy a malicious Application → privileged pods → full Kubernetes cluster takeover. Affects < 2.10-rc2 / 2.9.4 / 2.8.8 / 2.7.15. Fixed by rejecting non-GET requests without application/json Content-Type. Lab: stdlib-only mock of the Argo CD API; the exploit plays the victim browser (modeling SameSite-Lax + CORS preflight rules itself) and forges an Application from a sibling subdomain; contract STATUS/APP verified via the applications oracle; fix = require application/json on non-GET → 4xx fail-closed, mirroring the upstream breaking change.

title: Canto remote file inclusion (CVE-2023-3452)
related: lab-20-php-filter-chain: both abuse PHP include sinks — RFI needs allow_url_include, filter chains need nothing writable
lab-21-wp-file-inclusion: same family — file inclusion; lab 21 reads local files via traversal, lab 22 executes remote code via include
summary: CVE-2023-3452 (CVSS 9.8): unauthenticated wp_abspath parameter passed into require_once() — data:// wrapper gives single-request RCE when allow_url_include=On. RFI is nearly extinct in modern apps; the misconfiguration is the teaching point.

title: CVE-2023-22515: Confluence BFLA → rantai setup → admin takeover
summary: GET /server-info.action with XWork-style parameter binding bootstrapStatusProvider.applicationConfig.setupComplete=0 flips setup state on an already-configured instance — broken function-level authorization on /setup/*, CWE-285. Attacker chains setupadministrator-start → setupadministrator.action to create an administrator, then dologin → full ATO with zero authentication. Affects Confluence Data Center/Server 8.0.0–8.5.1 (fixed 8.3.3/8.4.3/8.5.2+), CVSS 10.0, CISA KEV, exploited by nation-state actors. Lab: lightweight stdlib-only mock; exploit contract STATUS/ADMIN_TOKEN, token proven via independent /me oracle (is_admin); fix = /server-info.action read-only + /setup/* → 403 after setup complete (fail-closed, mirrors Atlassian's interim mitigation).

title: CVE-2023-28131: Expo OAuth proxy open redirect → ATO
related: lab-27-khan-academy-regex-bypass: both are redirect-driven token theft → ATO; Khan bypasses an unescaped-dot regex, Expo bypasses a case-sensitive scheme check
summary: AuthSession proxy (auth.expo.io) stored attacker-influenced returnUrl in an ru cookie, then redirected the OAuth fragment (code+token) to it — the case-sensitive scheme check was bypassed with mixed-case hTTps://. Full ATO demonstrated on Codecademy. CVSS 9.6, hotfixed within hours. Lab: mock OAuth proxy + IdP, no browser needed; fix = case-insensitive scheme + host allowlist (400).

title: GitLab password reset array pollution → ATO (H1 #2293343)
related: lab-30-stripe-email-idor-ato: both are → ATO via account identity flows; GitLab pollutes the reset recipient, Stripe changes the account email
summary: user[email] sent as a JSON array where a string was expected → the mailer fanned the password-reset link out to every address in the array → one-request ATO with no victim interaction. Critical 10.0, $35,000. Lab: mock reset API + @attacker.lab-scoped mock inbox; exploit pollutes the array, takes the token from own inbox, resets and logs in as victim (TOKEN validated via /me oracle + old password must fail); fix = strict type check: email must be a string → 400 fail-closed.

title: Apache 2.4.49 path traversal (CVE-2021-41773)
related: lab-23-gitlab-maven-traversal: same root-cause class — decode-ordering: lab 23 validated the pre-decoded URL, lab 24 checked for .. before decoding %2e to .; lab 23 writes files, lab 24 reads them
lab-21-wp-file-inclusion: same attack family, different root cause — lab 21 is canonicalization without containment, lab 24 is check-then-decode ordering
summary: Disclosed H1 report ($4,000 Internet Bug Bounty on the report page): 2.4.49 checked the path for ../ BEFORE decoding %2e to ., so /.%2e/ segments became live traversal after the check. With ScriptAlias /cgi-bin/ + mod_cgi, a GET reads files outside the web root (e.g. /etc/passwd). Fix is config hardening (Require all denied, per the official advisory); 2.4.50's fix was incomplete (CVE-2021-42013), so the upgrade note says >= 2.4.51.

title: GitLab X-HTTP-Method-Override cache poisoning
summary: Method-override header turns a cacheable GET into an error response that gets cached — cache-poisoned denial of service. $2,500.

related: lab-10-0cl-expect-desync: desync family

title: Stripe email change IDOR → ATO (H1 #1250037)
related: lab-28-paypal-idor-privesc: both are IDOR in account management; Stripe takes over accounts via email change, PayPal escalates privilege across merchants
lab-29-valve-cdkeys-idor: both are missing object authorization; Stripe mutates account identity → ATO, Valve leaks mass CD keys
lab-31-gitlab-reset-array-pollution: both are → ATO via account identity flows; Stripe changes the account email, GitLab pollutes the reset recipient
summary: Email-change flow on indiehackers.com (Stripe) took user_id from the request without binding it to the session → attacker changed a victim's account email to one they owned, then password-reset → ATO. Medium → critical. Lab: mock account API; exploit runs the full chain (change email → reset → login as victim, TOKEN validated via /me oracle + old credentials must fail); fix = user_id must equal session + password confirmation (403 fail-closed).

title: H2C Smuggling

title: Abusing HTTP hop-by-hop request headers
summary: Connection header tricks proxies into stripping security headers (X-Forwarded-For, Authorization) before the backend — enabling admin bypass and IP spoofing.

title: Cache Poisoned Denial of Service (CPDoS)
summary: Caching error responses (e.g. 403s) triggered by attacker-controlled headers — denial of service for every user behind the cache.

title: GitLab Maven registry traversal to authorized_keys write (HackerOne #733072)
related: lab-19-zip-slip: same primitive class — arbitrary file write via traversal; lab 19 via archive entry names, lab 23 via an API file_name segment
lab-21-wp-file-inclusion: same root-cause class — canonicalization without containment; lab 21 reads files, lab 23 writes them
summary: Disclosed H1 report ($1,000 bounty): the Grape router validated the pre-decoded URL, so %2e%2e%2f in the Maven file_name segment passed the no-slash regex — a PUT then wrote the attacker's SSH key over authorized_keys. Traversal on a write sink beats traversal on a read sink.

title: MoPub login open redirect → XSS via javascript: URI (H1 #683298)
related: lab-27-khan-academy-regex-bypass: both are open redirects with real impact; MoPub escalates to XSS via javascript: scheme, Khan steals an auth-transfer token
summary: app.mopub.com/login?next= accepted arbitrary destinations including the javascript: scheme; post-login navigation used window.location.href, so the javascript: URI executed as reflected XSS in the victim's session. Bounty paid (amount not shown on the report page). Lab is the first client-side build, verified with a headless-Chromium sidecar that proves JS execution. Fix: allowlist next to relative paths, reject schemes with 400.

title: PayPal CL.TE desync to stored XSS

High 7.1, $10,500 bounty. Lab: mock merchant API; fix = is_member(email, account_id) before any mutation (cross-merchant → 403).

title: Valve partner CD keys IDOR (H1 #391217)
related: lab-32-indico-principals-bola: both are missing object authorization → mass exposure; Valve exposes game CD keys, Indico exposes user PII
lab-28-paypal-idor-privesc: both are IDOR/BOLA in partner account flows; Valve leaks mass CD keys, PayPal escalates privilege across merchants

Critical, $20,000 bounty ($15k + bonus).
